findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pre_mortem · Private data: rare_insider_trades, insider_record · Public sink: latest_results, pre_mortem, fund_moves, leaderboard · Destructive: leaderboard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pre_mortem · Private data: rare_insider_trades, insider_record · Public sink: latest_results, pre_mortem, fund_moves, leaderboard · Destructive: leaderboard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
